title: Complete Erdős Problem #1041: Paths in Polynomial Level Sets (Work in Progress)

problemStatement.formal: f \text{ monic},\ \text{roots} \subseteq \overline{\mathbb{D}} \implies \exists \text{ path of length} < 2 \text{ in } \{z:|f(z)|<1\} \text{ joining two roots}
problemStatement.plain: For a monic polynomial with all roots in the unit disk, must there exist a path of length less than 2 in the sublevel set {z : |f(z)| < 1} connecting two roots?
whyMatters: Connectivity of polynomial sublevel sets links complex analysis to metric geometry of lemniscates.
